name: Ego-Exo4D
tagline: 1,286 h of time-synced ego (Aria) + exo (GoPro) video of 740 participants doing skilled activities at 123 sites in 13 cities.

annotations.coverageNote: Atomic descriptions on 4,965/5,035 takes (~98.6%, 432K sentences); keysteps, proficiency, EgoPose and relation masks cover benchmark subsets.

action_labels.note: Keystep segments (step_name, start/end, is_essential) on procedural takes

object_boxes.note: Relations: one 2D box per active object on the ego clip

segmentation.note: Relations: per-frame ego + exo object masks (encodedMask) with click logs

hand_pose.note: EgoPose: 21 joints per hand in 3D + 2D ego/exo projections

gaze.note: Aria MPS eye gaze per take

camera_pose.note: Aria MPS 6-DoF trajectories; per-take intrinsics/extrinsics for all cameras

scene_3d.note: MPS semi-dense point clouds per capture

audio_transcript.note: Expert commentary transcriptions; multichannel audio in VRS
